Google Patches Chrome Zero-Day CVE-2025-10585 as Active V8 Exploit Threatens Millions

Amadu Jalloh · 18th September 2025

Google released a Chrome update in September 2025 addressing CVE-2025-10585, a V8 vulnerability that had been exploited in the wild.

What to do

Update Chrome through its About screen, restart the browser, and verify that your organization’s managed devices have received the update.
